scientific_integrity: All constants follow from the exact Gram density and a strict constrained saddle; finite numerical checks support but cannot prove the limiting assertion.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic is for three independent volume-uniform vertices of the d-dimensional unit ball, d tending to infinity. The conditional six-dimensional Gram-coordinate law is in total variation, without a quantified finite-dimensional convergence rate. Accessible historical literature provides the marginal acute-triangle integral; historical priority for the marked law remains provisional because full text of Hall (1982) was not obtainable.
title: Sharp rare-obtuse asymptotics and the marked boundary layer of random ball triangles
